title: AI prompt → clean low-poly model: testing game-ready asset generation [Free]
author: spacespacespapce
selftext:
**What:** Low-poly duck

**Tri count:** 432

**Format:** .blend, .glb included

**Download:** [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X5dtPPVYZ4rp7q9bzMZbHZ10o\_ap7Tnn?usp=drive\_link](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X5dtPPVYZ4rp7q9bzMZbHZ10o_ap7Tnn?usp=drive_link)

  
I've been experimenting with AI → game-ready workflows and wanted to share free resources as I make them. Going for a low-poly style.

Feedback welcome - what other asset types would be useful?

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body:
Generated these using a text-to-Blender tool I've been working on (nativeblend.app if anyone wants to try). 

Still refining the workflow but wanted to share what's possible.

Happy to answer questions about the process!

comments.author: sense-net-mccoy
comments.body: I wouldn't call that game-ready. The eyes and beak aren't attached to the head.

replies.author: SuBw00FeR37
replies.body: I mean sure but it would take 2 mins to fix, instead of a couple hours to make from scratch, massive time saving, and that's just in this state, once it's iterated upon more, probably wont have those issues.

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: I wouldn't trust or download any asset pack as lazily done as this one.

replies.author: cavallo922
replies.body: Any 3d artist thats worth something can make stuff like this in under 10 minutes tbh

replies.author: ThrowawayToothQ
replies.body: Yeah its precisely two squashed icospheres, 4 cylinders, two rectangles and 3 triangle-prisms

replies.author: Erik_malkavia
replies.body: It's only eye...Give the OP a break

replies.author: sense-net-mccoy
replies.body: Dude, he's here promoting his soon-to-be paid service with a dishonest request for our "feedback", thereby violating the rules of the sub. I ain't cutting him any slack.

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body:
Ahh I uploaded the 2nd last render instead of the last one - can't edit this post but I've updated the thumbnail on [itch.io](https://asdf1235.itch.io/low-poly-model-pack).

Thanks for the feedback!

replies.author: ThrowawayToothQ
replies.body: How would a re-render have any bearing on the model being rendered? Youre a grifter and your tool does not work.

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body:
Let me add some clarification. These models are created through multiple iterations of the AI tool controlling Blender. 


Each iteration, the model is cleaned up.



I uploaded the 2nd last iteration, where small details like the eyes weren't positioned properly.


The goal is to make game-ready assets but it's still very much a work in progress.

comments.author: buu_ai
comments.body: Looks good. Have you tried other platforms? You can check out Buu and compare too. We would love some feedback

replies.author: samanthablacktattoo
replies.body: Hey Buu! I tried your app and it was pretty bad,  I asked it for a centaur and it gave me a blob riding a blob horse. I do not recommend it. I'll go take a screenshot of it so I can comment it under all these advertisements.

replies.author: buu_ai
replies.body: Thank you for your feedback. We will improve it

comments.author: xjxxjx1017
comments.body: How do you do remesh? AI generated assets usually have high mesh count. I've tried remesh tools, but usually they end up losing the original shape when going to a very low mesh count, say < 500

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body: This isn't a raw "AI generated" model - instead AI was used to control the "building" of the model with tools like Blender. So it's "AI built" (??) haha still figuring out the right terminology

replies.author: xjxxjx1017
replies.body: Ohhh... Great! I guess you were using Blender MCP. Good to know that it worked out!

comments.author: MessageSelfdestructs
comments.body:
These look horrible... Not even close to production ready...

Actual good models, and not models that resemble the object, but are actually properly modeled...
